title: cyphostemma gilletii
intro: Cyphostemma gilletii, commonly known as African Potato, is a succulent plant native to Africa. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Cyphostemma gilletii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents of this plant may also contribute to its potential anticancer and neuroprotective effects, although further studies are needed to confirm these findings.
